column12: + Mary bowed and wept, under the feet of the Lord, saying “Look and have mercy on me, according to Your goodness.”

column12: Who is like You among the gods, O our good Savior, with the power of Your divinity, You raised Lazarus the just.

column12: When our Lord Jesus, saw everyone weeping, He sighed in the spirit, “Lazarus rise and come forth.”

column12: + And His soul was troubled, He cried out saying, “Where was he laid, Lazarus the beloved.”

column12: Forgive us our iniquities, grant us salvation, through the prayers and intercessions, of the Lady of us all Mary.

column12: + O Savior of the whole world, our true God, we believe with all our hearts, for You are the King also.
